instruction: Please install the custom Chrome extension from the Desktop directory and verify that 'Hello Extensions' version 1.0 is successfully loaded.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing an unpacked Chrome extension and verifying both name and version. Custom getter reads Chrome Preferences to extract all extension details (name, version, description, manifest_version). Metric checks if an extension with name 'Hello Extensions' and version '1.0' exists in the list.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: extension name 'Hello Extensions' and version '1.0'
Getter logic correctly extracts extension details from Chrome Preferences file (extensions.settings) across different OS platforms
Metric comparison logic correctly checks for matching extension name and version in the list of installed extensions
Parameter handling is correct: when expected.type='rule', the metric receives the rules dict directly and correctly accesses expected.get('name') and expected.get('version')
State accessibility is robust: Chrome Preferences file is persistent and doesn't require UI to be open, so no postconfig needed
Expected values semantically match the instruction: name='Hello Extensions' and version='1.0'
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified
Edge case handling: getter returns empty list on error, metric returns 0.0 when extension not found
